scoped_findings: IID percentile bootstrap (M1, used in Phase 7.21/7.25/7.27) is miscalibrated under clustered/overlapping events: type I 0.17-0.29, CI coverage 0.71-0.85; liberal at n<=25 (0.08-0.10) with independent events.

Engine block methods: studentized block bootstrap (M3) never exceeds the protocol band ceiling 0.075 (max 0.0725, clustered n=200); block sign-flip (M2) exceeds it once (0.0825, clustered n=200, ~0.5 MC SE above 0.075) and has no power at n=12. Both are conservative (<0.025) in some small-n and n=400 cells. CORRECTION: the original Decision Card and chat report rounded this to '<=0.08, calibrated in all configurations'; the exact figures above prevail. Verdict unchanged (a calibrated alternative, M3, exists).

holdout_statement: No sealed holdout and no ValidationAccessLedger path was read. Inputs are discovery data already exposed in Phases 7.21/7.24/7.27. The D1 CSV (2019-01-02..2026-08-19) overlaps in calendar dates the Phase 7 final_holdout_seal_v1 window (2026-02-04..2026-09-16), but that seal governs the Phase 7 partitioned market-state dataset, not this CSV, which Phase 7.27 already read in full. No real strategy signal was evaluated: events are synthetic draws.
limits: explore.py was run before freezing the protocol to read data scale (ATR, outcome sd, trade R distributions); disclosed, no effect sizes were tested.
A timing smoke test ran 5 reps of 4 cells before the full run; outputs were not inspected.
M1 uses B=2000 bootstrap draws (Phase 7.27 used 10,000).
Clustered generator G_C is one stylized dependence model (clusters of 4 events, 2 bars apart).
Trade layer resamples 47/42 real trades IID: tails limited to observed values, no serial dependence.
Single instrument (GOLD) and two strategies' R distributions.
At n=400 events cover 21% of eligible D1 bars: finite-population effect makes block methods conservative there.
Regime tercile edges are full-sample (inherited from Phase 7.27 classifier).
Expected beta-confusion of the unconditional benchmark (M_UNC) did not materialize (0.06-0.12); reported as found.
protocol_v1.sha256 contains the original scratchpad absolute path (kept byte-identical).
The proposed power gate is a proposal, not adopted policy.
